title: Tokyu S Reys Football School Ikebukuro: Player Match 2504 Highlights
text:
Is your young soccer player ready to take their game to the next level? The Tokyu S reyes Football School Ikebukuro is hosting a unique “ Player’s Match ” designed to cultivate leadership and strategic thinking in young athletes. Learn all the details about this exciting youth soccer event,including how to register and what to expect.
Tokyu S Reyes Football School Ikebukuro to Host ‘Player’s Match’ April 9, 2025
Empowering Young Athletes Thru Player-Led Competition Ikebukuro, tokyo – The Tokyu S Reyes Football School ikebukuro is set to host a unique event titled Player’s Match , designed to foster leadership and strategic thinking among young soccer players. this innovative competition empowers participants to take full control of their team, from selecting members to devising game strategies.
Event Highlights: Cultivating Growth and Independence The Player’s Match aims to cultivate players’ abilities to grow independently by encouraging them to think critically and collaboratively. While coaches will be present to ensure fair play and adherence to event rules,they will refrain from providing guidance or instructions during the matches. This hands-off approach allows children, even those new to the sport, to participate with confidence and learn through experience.
The school encourages participation, stating, Why not take part in an event filled with opportunities to grow? They added, We look forward to your participation.
Key Event details Content: Players will strategize and execute their game plans, considering team composition and tactics. Event Rules: Coaches and parents are prohibited from offering advice or instructions during the event. All players must participate as field players in every match. Each player is required to serve as a goalkeeper at least once. Playing time will be distributed as equally as possible among all participants. Date: April 29 (Fire Congratulations) Time: 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM U-9 (2nd and 3rd grade elementary school students) U-11 (4th and 5th grade elementary school students) Eligibility: Open to members and non-members in 2nd to 5th grade. Capacity: 16 participants per age group. *A minimum of 10 participants per group is required for the event to proceed (decision made 3 days prior). Location: Adidas Futsal Park Ikebukuro, LABI1 LIFE SELECT, 6F Rooftop, 1-5-7 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku, Tokyo 170-0013 *3-minute walk from Ikebukuro Station on the JR Line Telephone: 03-5953-2270 Opening Hours: Weekdays: 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM Saturdays, Sundays, and Holidays: 10:30 AM to 11:00 PM Fees and Required Items Fees (Tax Included): members: ¥2,200 per session Non-members: ¥2,420 per session *Non-members can avail of the member price by registering with a member friend. *Advance online payment is required. Required Accessories: Appropriate athletic wear Non-spike shoes Shin guards Water towel Critically important Notices In case of rain, a decision regarding cancellation will be made one hour before the event’s start time. Participants should check the school website or call for updates. Class availability varies by grade, and waitlists will be implemented for fully booked classes. Cancellations must be made through the participant’s My Page. Cancellations after 8:00 PM the day before the event will incur the full fee as a cancellation charge. Participants are responsible for their own insurance coverage, as the event is not covered by insurance. Registration Details New participants should register on the My Page registration page,providing necessary information and credit card details. After registration, access the event schedule (event schedule for 2nd and 3rd graders, event schedule ② for 4th and 5th graders), select the event date, and complete the submission.
contact Information For inquiries, please use the enquiry button on the school’s website.
For more information, visit: https://www.tokyu-sports.com/football/reyes/school/ikebukuro/news_list/event/2025_year/players_match_250429.html
